title: Form 8-K WESTERN DIGITAL CORP For: Aug 05
summary: Western Digital Corporation filed a Form 8-K on August 5, 2026, announcing its financial results for the fiscal fourth quarter and year ended July 3, 2026. The press release containing these results is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the filing. This information is furnished under Item 2.02 of the Form 8-K.

title: Runway Growth Finance Corp. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Dividend of $0.33 per Share
summary: Runway Growth Finance Corp. (Nasdaq: RWAY) announced a third quarter 2026 cash dividend of $0.33 per share. The dividend's declaration date is August 5, 2026, with a record date of August 17, 2026, and a payment date of August 31, 2026. The company intends to distribute substantially all available earnings quarterly and operates an "opt out" dividend reinvestment plan for stockholders.

title: Why Revvity (RVTY) Stock Is Up Today
summary: Shares of Revvity (NYSE:RVTY) jumped 3.1% after the life sciences company reported strong second-quarter 2026 results that exceeded Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year guidance. The company announced adjusted EPS of $1.41 on revenue of $729.68 million, driven by 11% organic growth in its Diagnostics segment. Analysts at Stifel and Bernstein increased their price targets for RVTY following the positive report.

title: Why Insulet (PODD) Shares Are Sliding Today
summary: Insulet Corporation (PODD) shares dropped significantly after the company reported strong second-quarter results but issued a weaker-than-expected revenue forecast for the third quarter. While Q2 revenue and EPS beat estimates, the lower guidance for the upcoming quarter led to a sell-off. The stock has seen considerable volatility and is down 52.7% year-to-date.

title: Analysts say oil profit critics don't understand how market works
summary: Oil companies, including Exxon Mobil and Chevron, reported significant profit increases in the second quarter due to rising oil prices driven by the conflict with Iran. Analysts argue that these profits are a result of basic market dynamics, specifically supply and demand influenced by geopolitical events, rather than corporate manipulation. They emphasize that such earnings are crucial for investment in production and ultimately for stabilizing prices for consumers.

title: Prudential, HSBC and Stan Chart tumble as China closes offshore tax loophole
summary: Shares of Prudential, HSBC, and Standard Chartered fell significantly after reports that China has started taxing returns from offshore insurance policies. This move closes a regulatory loophole that previously allowed wealthy mainland Chinese customers to use Hong Kong insurance products for investment and financial diversification. The new tax directly impacts companies like Prudential, which relies heavily on the Hong Kong and mainland China markets for new business.

title: Southern California Edison tower sparked devastating LA County's Eaton fire, report finds
summary: A report from the Los Angeles County Fire Department concluded that electrical sparks from an out-of-service Southern California Edison transmission tower caused the devastating 2025 Eaton Fire. This blaze killed 19 people, destroyed thousands of homes, and engulfed over 14,000 acres, leading to potential billions in liabilities for Edison. The utility has already established a compensation fund and settled over 2,400 claims, acknowledging its equipment's likely role in the fire.

title: |‘The crisis will come to an end,’ Mosaic reports $273m net loss in Q2 2026 amid fertilizer volatility
summary: |Mosaic reported a net loss of $273 million in Q2 2026, primarily due to fertilizer market volatility caused by the Iran war and constrained sulfur supplies, forcing the company to idle production facilities. Despite challenges, CEO Bruce Bodine stated Mosaic is taking actions to weather the storm while preserving its ability to ramp up production quickly when conditions improve. The company's biosciences division, Mosaic Biosciences, was a positive outlier, projected to double its net sales in 2026.

title: Gartner Marks Enterprise Move from AI Experiments to AI Engineering
summary: Gartner's "Hype Cycle for Enterprise Architecture, 2026" report indicates a significant shift in enterprises from AI experimentation to full-scale AI engineering. The report highlights that organizations are now focused on building robust engineering, governance, and data foundations to operate AI reliably and at scale. This new phase emphasizes the critical role of AI engineering, AI governance, and multiagent systems in integrating AI across products, services, and business operations.

title: Healthcare Stocks Have Been Forgotten. Eli Lilly, McKesson, and 9 More to Buy.
summary: The market has overlooked the healthcare sector this year, making many stocks within it, including Eli Lilly and McKesson, appear attractive to investors. This article suggests that numerous healthcare and pharmaceutical stocks are poised for a rise despite current market fixations on other sectors.

title: Clearwater acquisition to ‘turbocharge’ KeyCorp’s investment banking business
summary: KeyCorp's acquisition of Clearwater is expected to significantly boost its investment banking business. The article highlights this strategic move by KeyCorp, which is headquartered in downtown Cleveland. The author is Jeremy Nobile, and the article was published on August 5, 2026.

title: Germantown biopharma Precigen turns first quarterly profit after key drug scores FDA approval
summary: Germantown-based biopharma company Precigen Inc. has reported its first quarterly profit. This achievement comes a year after its immunotherapy drug received FDA approval, with sales of the drug being the main driver of the profit.

title: John Deere, UAW ‘Half a Billion Dollars’ Apart in Contract Extension Clash
summary: John Deere proposed a two-year extension of its labor agreement with the UAW, which would last through 2029, citing weaker equipment demand. However, the UAW's counteroffer exceeded Deere's proposal by approximately half a billion dollars, leading to a standoff. The UAW criticized Deere for not respecting the bargaining process, while Deere highlighted benefits of its extension offer, including a $3,000 bonus and wage increases.

title: Alexandria Stands to Lose Nearly $200M on Kips Bay Project
summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities is facing a potential loss of $183 million in preconstruction costs for the third building of its Kips Bay life sciences campus due to an ongoing dispute with New York City. The conflict, which began over two years ago, involves accusations from Alexandria that the city blocked construction, and counter-allegations from the city regarding the developer's failure to disclose information and close an option by a deadline. This legal battle is unfolding as New York's life sciences market experiences a downturn with increasing vacancy rates.

title: Franklin Resources (BEN) Is Up 7.3% After Strong Q3, Rebrand To Franklin Templeton, New Credit Facility
summary: Franklin Resources (BEN) reported strong Q3 2026 results with higher revenue and earnings, along with a planned rebranding to Franklin Templeton, Inc. and new financing. The company is focusing on global expansion, particularly in ETFs and private markets, supported by a new US$1.50 billion revolving credit facility. Analysts project increased revenue and earnings by 2029, though the stock currently shows a slight downside to fair value.

title: EOG Resources Inc Stock (EOG) Moved Down by 5.81% on Aug 5: A Full Analysis
summary: EOG Resources Inc (EOG) stock dropped by 5.81% on August 5th due to missing quarterly earnings expectations, higher operational costs, and a downward revision in full-year production guidance. Broader macroeconomic headwinds, including declining crude oil prices and cooling global industrial demand, exacerbated the sell-off in the energy sector. Analysts have issued mixed reactions, with some lowering price targets, suggesting the stock will remain under pressure until there is more clarity on global energy demand and cost containment.

title: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. (OESX) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
summary: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. (OESX) reported a Q1 EPS of $0.47, significantly beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of a $0.01 loss, and also surpassed revenue expectations with $25.74 million. Despite the strong quarterly performance, the company's shares have underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date, and its current outlook, based on earnings estimate revisions, results in a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

title: Goldman Sachs stock doubles from 'Liberation Day' lows
summary: Goldman Sachs stock has doubled since President Trump's "Liberation Day" announcement on April 3, 2025, closing at $1,052.98 on Tuesday. This significant growth is attributed to strong quarterly performances, a turbulent financial market environment, and a reopening of M&A and IPO markets. Bank of America analysts have raised their price target for Goldman Sachs to $1,300, emphasizing its direct exposure to the global capital markets cycle and potential benefits from the AI boom.

title: Qualys (QLYS) Soars As Earnings Beat And AI Security Push Ignite Rally
summary: Qualys (QLYS) shares rallied 15.8% after reporting strong Q2 earnings, beating analyst expectations on both revenue and EPS, and raising its full-year guidance. The company's push into AI security with new tools like InstaScan and broader TotalAI capabilities, coupled with its robust financial performance, has ignited investor confidence. JPMorgan lifted its price target to $150, citing strong cybersecurity spending and AI tailwinds.

title: Mid-America Apartment Communities Vs. W. P. Carey: Why One REIT Dividend Claimed 86% Of Core AFFO
summary: This article compares the dividend payout ratios of Mid-America Apartment Communities (MAA) and W. P. Carey (WPC) based on their second-quarter 2026 earnings. MAA's dividend consumed 86% of its Core AFFO, while W. P. Carey's used 70% of its reported AFFO. The article delves into each company's financial performance, guidance, and the factors influencing their respective payout cushions.

title: Basketball legend Yao Ming takes delivery of Nio ES9 after 2 months
summary: Basketball legend Yao Ming has received his Nio ES9, over two months after placing his order for the vehicle. Despite being named the ES9's chief experience officer, Yao had to wait due to a strong demand and order backlog for the flagship SUV. Nio's ES9 has seen significant success, with waiting times for high-end versions still at 13 to 14 weeks and the company expecting to reach its 20,000th delivery this week.

title: Moody’s upgrades Newell Brands outlook on improved sales By Investing.com
summary: Moody’s has upgraded Newell Brands' outlook to stable from negative, affirming its B1 Corporate Family Rating. This improvement is attributed to Newell's enhanced operating performance in Q2 2026, including a return to year-over-year revenue growth, and expectations of continued earnings growth from market share gains and a shift towards premium products. The company's commitment to reducing leverage and strong free cash flow generation are expected to improve its credit metrics, despite a challenging consumer environment.

title: General Dynamics Keeps Quarterly Dividend at $1.59 a Share, Payable Nov. 13 to Holders of Record Oct. 9
summary: General Dynamics Corporation has announced that it will maintain its quarterly dividend at $1.59 per share. The dividend is scheduled to be paid on November 13 to shareholders of record as of October 9. This announcement reaffirms the company's commitment to its dividend policy.

title: EOG accumulates Austin Chalk position that adds a year to inventories
summary: EOG Resources has expanded its Austin Chalk position by leasing 60,000 net acres in Lavaca County, which its COO described as a "sweet spot" that could pay for itself in less than a year. This acquisition adds a year's worth of two-mile lateral inventory to EOG's current Eagle Ford activity levels and is expected to contribute to future growth. Additionally, Crescent Energy has raised its full-year production forecast after strong second-quarter earnings, attributed to efficient operations and asset performance across multiple basins.

title: Moderna Appeals District Court Infringement Judgment over COVID Vaccines
summary: Moderna has appealed a District Court judgment concerning patent infringement related to its COVID-19 vaccines, arguing that the U.S. government, not Moderna, should bear the liability under 28 U.S.C. § 1498(a). The company claims that its Spikemax® vaccine was developed and distributed "for the United States" and with the government's authorization and consent during the pandemic. Moderna's appeal to the Federal Circuit emphasizes policy considerations, statutory interpretation, and the critical role of private industry in national emergencies.

title: AI Agents Move to the Center of Gartner's 2026 Cloud-Native Magic Quadrant
summary: Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Platforms highlights the increasing importance of AI-agent support in platform evaluations. While major players like Google, Microsoft, and AWS remain Leaders, new entrants like Oracle and Tencent Cloud have joined, emphasizing the market's shift towards integrating AI agents, governance, and cost controls. The report also notes a growing enterprise preference for consistent, governed platforms over maximum multicloud portability.

title: NRG Energy reveals details on $3.2 billion data center power project, its first in Texas
summary: NRG Energy has announced details of a $3.2 billion data center power project in Texas, marking its first such venture in the state. This announcement comes just a day after Texas Governor Greg Abbott ordered a halt on data center approvals pending a state audit. NRG plans for this to be the first of several data center projects it intends to develop.

title: General Dynamics Board Declares Dividend
summary: General Dynamics (NYSE: GD) announced that its board of directors has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.59 per share on the company's common stock. The dividend is payable on November 13, 2026, to shareholders of record on October 9, 2026. General Dynamics is a global aerospace and defense company with over 120,000 employees, reporting $52.6 billion in revenue in 2025.

title: Baird Adjusts Price Target on Zimmer Biomet to $104 From $92, Maintains Neutral Rating
summary: Baird has raised its price target for Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (ZBH) to $104 from $92, while maintaining a Neutral rating on the stock. This adjustment comes amidst a flurry of analyst activity, with several other firms also updating their price targets for the medical equipment company. The article also provides a brief company profile and lists recent news and financial data for Zimmer Biomet.

title: The TJX Companies Q2 Results: Earnings date set for August 19
summary: The TJX Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TJX) is scheduled to release its second quarter Fiscal 2027 sales and earnings results on Wednesday, August 19, 2026, before 9:30 a.m. ET. CEO Ernie Herrman will host a conference call at 11:00 a.m. ET to discuss the results, operations, and business trends, with a webcast available on TJX.com and a replay accessible until August 25, 2026. This announcement provides investors with a timeline to evaluate the off-price retailer's performance amidst current consumer spending patterns.

title: Investors brace for Sempra earnings amid regulatory headwinds By Investing.com
summary: Sempra Energy is set to report its second-quarter earnings, with analysts projecting increased EPS and revenue year-over-year, despite a sequential decline from the previous quarter. The company faces regulatory uncertainties in Texas and California, its primary markets, which could impact its Oncor unit. Investors will be closely watching Sempra's ability to maintain growth and operational efficiency amidst these headwinds, especially given the divergence between rising EPS estimates and slightly declining revenue forecasts.

title: Is Omnicom (OMC) Quietly Redefining Its Investment Story With Aggressive Buybacks And New AI Tools?
summary: Omnicom Group (OMC) recently reported strong Q2 2026 sales and net income, alongside a significant share buyback of 34.8 million shares worth US$2.77 billion. The company is also deepening its data- and AI-enabled communication capabilities with new tools like WEATHERVaiNE, aiming to strengthen its investment narrative. While these actions support near-term growth, investors are cautioned about the ongoing risk of clients shifting to in-house AI tools.

title: McKesson earnings up next: Can revenue rebound after Q4 miss?
summary: McKesson is set to report its fiscal first-quarter earnings, with analysts anticipating a rebound in revenue after a significant miss in the previous quarter. Investors will be scrutinizing how the pharmaceutical distributor plans to address increasing competition from direct-to-patient platforms and other sector-wide challenges, despite strong operational execution in prior periods. The stock is rated as a "Buy" by analysts, with a mean price target suggesting a 14% upside.

title: MetLife earnings in the spotlight as Street weighs outlook By Investing.com
summary: MetLife Inc. is scheduled to release its second-quarter earnings, with analysts anticipating $2.34 per share on $19.68 billion in revenue, reflecting year-over-year growth. Despite a generally positive Wall Street sentiment and several analyst target raises, EPS estimates have seen a recent decline, tempering profit expectations. Investors will closely monitor premium growth, annuity sales, performance in Asia, and margin management as the company's stock approaches its 52-week high.

title: Keurig Dr Pepper earnings on deck: Can coffee deal deliver? By Investing.com
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) is set to report Q2 earnings, with analysts anticipating EPS of 54 cents and revenue of $7.24 billion, reflecting the impact of its $18 billion JDE Peet’s acquisition. Investors will be closely watching the integration of JDE Peet's, progress on deleveraging, the sustainability of growth in U.S. Refreshment Beverages, and the recovery of coffee margins, especially following a key leadership departure. The report will provide insight into KDP's strategy to become a global coffee powerhouse and its path to splitting into two companies by early 2027.

title: Howmet Aerospace earnings up next: Can growth momentum hold? By Investing.com
summary: Howmet Aerospace (HWM) is set to report its second-quarter earnings, with analysts expecting significant year-over-year growth in both earnings per share and revenue. Wall Street remains largely bullish on the stock, with most analysts rating it a buy and suggesting further upside. Investors will be closely watching for commentary on aircraft production, aftermarket demand, and the integration of recent acquisitions, as well as the company's ability to maintain strong margins and deliver on elevated full-year EPS growth projections.

title: IQVIA (IQV) Teams Up With Medera To Push Cardiac Gene Therapy Forward
summary: IQVIA Holdings (NYSE:IQV) has announced a new alliance with Medera Inc. to advance cardiac gene therapy and human-based drug discovery by leveraging IQVIA's clinical trial infrastructure and Medera's gene therapy work. This partnership expands IQVIA's presence in gene therapies and innovative drug development, aligning with its existing focus on AI-powered data platforms and R&D solutions. Investors should monitor the collaboration's progress for signs of commercial traction and its impact on IQVIA's resource allocation and financial metrics.

title: News | This deal on upscale Mercer Island marks Seattle's biggest apartment sale of the year
summary: UDR, a multifamily real estate giant, has sold its Island Square property on Mercer Island for $157 million, marking Seattle's largest apartment sale of the year. The sale price translates to $668,000 per unit for the transit-oriented development. This transaction represents the highest price paid for apartments in the Puget Sound region in 2026.

title: ConocoPhillips set to report earnings amid oil volatility By Investing.com
summary: ConocoPhillips is expected to announce its second-quarter earnings, with analysts anticipating a significant sequential profit increase despite recent volatility in crude oil prices. The company's production performance, shareholder return strategy, and long-term plans for its Alaska projects, particularly after the Willow development, will be key areas of focus for investors. Wall Street maintains a largely bullish outlook on the stock, with most analysts recommending a buy rating.

title: ConocoPhillips set to report earnings amid oil volatility By Investing.com
summary: ConocoPhillips is anticipated to announce strong second-quarter earnings, with analysts expecting significant sequential profit growth despite recent drops in crude oil prices. The company is forecast to report $2.88 per share on $18.69 billion in revenue, driven by increased production and improved price realizations when oil prices surged above $120 per barrel. Investors will be closely watching production performance, adherence to shareholder return targets amidst oil price volatility, and the company's long-term strategy for its Alaska operations, particularly the Willow project.

title: Tyler Technologies Acquires CODY Systems
summary: Tyler Technologies has acquired CODY Systems, a Pennsylvania-based software and data management company specializing in public safety solutions. This acquisition expands Tyler's public safety portfolio by adding CODY Systems’ cloud-based records management (Pathfinder RMS) and cross-agency data-sharing platforms (COBRAnet), strengthening Tyler's competitive position in the small to midsize public safety market. The deal aims to provide public safety agencies with enhanced interoperability, real-time information access, and cost-effective solutions.

title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Initiates an Investigation into Allegations Against CarMax, Inc. (KMX) And Encourages Stockholders to Reach Out
summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC is investigating potential claims against CarMax, Inc. (KMX) regarding alleged corporate wrongdoing. The firm encourages CarMax investors who purchased securities prior to June 20, 2025, and continue to hold them, to contact them for more information and to assist in the investigation. The investigation aims to restore investor capital and ensure corporate accountability.

title: McKesson earnings up next: Can revenue rebound after Q4 miss? By Investing.com
summary: McKesson is set to release its fiscal first-quarter earnings, with investors closely watching for a rebound in revenue after a significant miss in the prior quarter. Analysts expect robust earnings and revenue growth, but the stock has experienced recent volatility due to concerns about direct-to-patient distribution and potential margin pressures from specialty pharmaceuticals and GLP-1 drugs. The upcoming earnings report will test whether McKesson's operational execution can overcome sector challenges and reassure investors about its market position.

title: Howmet Aerospace earnings up next: Can growth momentum hold? By Investing.com
summary: Howmet Aerospace is set to report its second-quarter results, with analysts anticipating significant year-over-year increases in earnings and revenue. The company is expected to continue its strong growth trajectory, driven by robust demand in commercial and defense aerospace markets and recent acquisitions. Investors will be closely watching management's commentary on production rates, aftermarket demand, integration of new acquisitions, and margin performance to see if Howmet can sustain its momentum.

title: Uber Stock Falls 4.8% as $10 Billion Robotaxi Bet Expands
summary: Uber's stock fell 4.8% after the company provided softer-than-expected third-quarter earnings guidance, despite strong operating growth. The company also announced plans to invest over $10 billion in expanding its robotaxi initiatives and recently acquired Delivery Hero for $14.8 billion. While its core business is thriving, investors are scrutinizing whether these massive investments will strengthen its competitive position or weigh on financial returns.

title: Higher taxes are a positive for tax-exempt munis, says Morgan Stanley's Craig Brandon
summary: Craig Brandon of Morgan Stanley discusses the municipal bond market, asserting that higher taxes positively impact tax-exempt municipal bonds. The article highlights his views on why these financial instruments become more attractive in a high-tax environment.

title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Is Investigating Altria Group, Inc. (MO) And Encourages Stockholders to Connect
summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC is investigating potential claims against Altria Group, Inc. (MO) after the company missed Q2 2026 earnings and revenue expectations and lowered its full-year guidance. The investigation focuses on whether Altria adequately disclosed risks related to its smoke-free product strategy and FDA authorization expectations, which impacted the stock price on July 30, 2026. Stockholders are encouraged to connect with the firm to assist in the investigation.

title: EA's $55bn sale to Saudi-led group closes — $700 million in cuts on the horizon
summary: Electronic Arts (EA) has finalized its $55 billion sale to a Saudi-led investment group, including Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners, taking the company private after 36 years. The deal saddles EA with $18 billion in debt, and the company plans to cut $700 million in annual costs, including $170 million from "organizational efficiencies," which analysts interpret as mass layoffs. The acquisition has also sparked concerns regarding the potential impact on EA's creative direction and Saudi Arabia's human rights record, particularly its stance on LGBT+ rights, which conflicts with themes in some EA games like The Sims.

title: Bank of America tech executive Liu leaving for competitor, memo says
summary: Ed Liu, Bank of America's vice chairman of technology and global head of software, has resigned to join a competitor. Liu, who previously worked at Morgan Stanley, joined Bank of America in early 2024. This departure follows Citi's recent announcement of hiring Rohan Sen from Bank of America for a similar role.

title: CVS Health Corp Stock (CVS) Moved Down by 4.65% on Aug 5: Drivers Behind the Movement
summary: CVS Health (CVS) stock declined by 4.65% on August 5th, primarily due to increased medical benefit ratios in its insurance division and a lowered full-year earnings guidance. The company faces ongoing challenges from elevated medical utilization rates, soft consumer spending, and reimbursement headwinds in its retail pharmacy segment. Additionally, regulatory scrutiny on pharmacy benefit managers and the departure of a key Aetna executive are contributing to investor uncertainty and defensive analyst reactions.
